name: org_graph_move_unit
description: Move a unit in the Org Graph beneath another live unit of a kind its own kind can sit under, or to the top when parent_id is omitted and its kind can sit there, from effective_on (today by default). Only a unit Espalia holds can be moved here. Moving a unit changes who inherits its ownership, so the caller needs rights on the unit and where it lands. To move a unit from the organisation's structure into a unit's own structure, pass conversion, a type of that structure for each type the unit and those beneath it hold; each changes type in the same change. That needs a tenant admin, and is one-way until a unit can move out of a structure; withdrawing the structure converts its units back, where they stay.

plan_id.description: the plan whose change this applies. Refused unless you may apply that plan's changes

plan_change_id.description: the plan change this applies; needs plan_id

cause_id.description: groups this with the plan's other changes, to change back together; needs plan_id

conversion.description: each level_id the unit or a unit beneath it holds => the level_id it becomes, a type of the structure it moves into
